items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I think it attempts to cover too much. It's an umbrella term that I think should not really have under it the music of Buddy Bolden and the music of Chick Corea.

ctx.x: 'jazz' as a valid term? Why don't you like 'jazz' -- I'm not asking what it is, but why ... what connotation does it have?
All right, because I think it attempts to cover too much. It's an umbrella term that I think should not really have under it the music of Buddy Bolden and the music of Chick Corea.
Uh huh. And it does cover them both.
